name: Featherbent
source:
The Strata serves as a homestead for a dichotomy of inhabitants: perches, who are passive, independent, and nomadic in nature, and hunters, who are built stronger, fiercer, with a higher population count, and a complex social network sorted rigidly by caste, the head of which make up the current ruling class.

Whether you're living by the light of mushrooms in the dark and damp Understory, within the bright, highly coveted spaces of the leafy Canopy, or the windy upper-class heights of the Emergent, the two classes live in harmony alongside one another, with all citizens celebrating their prosperity with a year-end tradition known as the Sweep.

When John Egbert carelessly treads the forbidden reaches of the Forest Floor, however, he finds that it shelters more than a few treacherous secrets about the place he was once proud to call home.

[From [url=http://featherbent.com]official site[/url]]
translation:
阶层是两种居民的家园：栖息地，本质上是被动的、独立的和游牧的；猎人，他们的身体更强大，更凶猛，人口数量更多，以及一个严格按种姓分类的复杂社会网络，其领导者构成了当前的统治阶级。

无论你是生活在黑暗潮湿的林下蘑菇的光下，还是生活在绿树成荫的树冠明亮、令人向往的空间里，还是生活在多风的上流社会高处，这两个阶层都和谐相处，所有公民都以一种被称为扫荡的年终传统来庆祝他们的繁荣。

然而，当约翰·埃格伯特漫不经心地踏上森林地面的禁区时，他发现这里隐藏着许多关于他曾经自豪地称之为家的地方的危险秘密。

[来自[url=http://featherbent.com]官方网站[/url]]
